html:
Woodes Rogers was an English sea captain and the first royal governor of the Bahamas, who ended the pirate republic at Nassau in 1718.

Earlier he had sailed around the world as a privateer and, in 1709, rescued the castaway Alexander Selkirk, the model for Robinson Crusoe. Arriving at Nassau with warships, he offered the king's pardon. Many pirates took it; he hanged several who went back to raiding.

His motto for the colony, pirates expelled, commerce restored, was on the seal of the Bahamas until 1973. He died in Nassau in 1732. His work helped end the Golden Age of Piracy across the British Caribbean.
sum: Woodes Rogers was an English sea captain and the first royal governor of the Bahamas, who ended the pirate republic at Nassau in 1718.
